plain_definition: A bank, restricted licence bank, or deposit-taking company authorized under Hong Kong's Banking Ordinance to carry on banking or deposit-taking business, and supervised by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA). HKMA's circulars on digital-asset custody, staking, and distribution of tokenised products are addressed to Authorized Institutions -- a different population of firms from the virtual asset trading platforms and other virtual-asset-service-provider types that the Securities and Futures Commission licenses separately.
formal_definition: A person authorized under the Banking Ordinance (Cap. 155) to carry on banking business or, for a deposit-taking company, business as a deposit-taking company; the category includes licensed banks, restricted licence banks, and deposit-taking companies, all supervised by HKMA.
